sentences.en: I don't like peas. They always fall off the knife.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢豌豆。它们总是从刀上掉下来。

sentences.en: He and his brother are two peas in a pod.
sentences.zh: 他和他的兄弟就像两颗豌豆一样相似。

sentences.en: The two brothers are like two peas in a pod.
sentences.zh: 那两个兄弟简直像两颗豌豆一样相似。

senses.zh: 豌豆（粒）；豆角；<西印度>豆荚
